description:
Follow-up to bd:JMAP-zx3s.9. The wire-spec-tightening (option 1) closes the correctness hole today by rejecting non-spec values at deserialize. A type-design improvement (option 2 from the original finding) would replace Option<serde_json::Value> with:

```rust
#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ParentIdFilter {
    /// Match only top-level mailboxes (wire: null).
    TopLevelOnly,
    /// Match mailboxes whose parent equals this Id.
    Equals(Id),
}

pub parent_id: Option<ParentIdFilter>,
```

With manual Serialize/Deserialize impls (null <-> TopLevelOnly, string <-> Equals(Id), anything else rejects). Wire-compatible with the current format.

**Why deferred:**
- Breaking API change for any consumer that constructs MailboxFilterCondition by struct literal with Option<serde_json::Value> (struct-literal blocked by non_exhaustive, but downstream test code in mail-server uses Option<Value>).
- Type-design improvement, not a present-tense correctness bug.
- Forward-major-version flag — natural to bundle with other type-design improvements at 1.0 or breaking releases.

**What's locked in now (from .9):**
- deserialize_parent_id_three_way rejects numbers, booleans, arrays, and nested objects at parse time.
- Test mailbox_filter_parent_id_rejects_non_spec_shapes asserts the four rejection cases.

**Scope when picked up:**
- New ParentIdFilter enum in jmap-mail-types::mailbox.
- Manual Serialize/Deserialize impls.
- MailboxFilterCondition.parent_id: Option<ParentIdFilter>.
- Migrate jmap-mail-server::memory::mailbox_matches_condition to match on ParentIdFilter instead of Value.
- Migrate jmap-mail-server::mailbox.rs filter parsing.
- Migrate any downstream test fixtures that construct Option<serde_json::Value>.
title: Consider typed ParentIdFilter enum for MailboxFilterCondition.parent_id (forward-major-version improvement)
